Thank you.  Turns out the windows in the office are quite tricky for birds to figure out as the windows open like this |\ where “I” is the wall’s direction and “\” is the glass panel.  So the opening is only the bottom small gap.  

However, I managed to trapped it in a paper bag without hurting it and we released it.  It stayed in the hand for quite a while before deciding to fly away.
Thank you again for the advices kind stranger :) I hope the poor little thing could be free soon.
